DRAFT — not yet included in ms.qmd. Wire in with {{< include _10-subsample-robustness.qmd >}}
after _08-sem.qmd (and probably after _09-bifactor.qmd) once the new data has been
re-pulled and this has been run/checked.

Addresses R1.2 ("the disproportionate # participants across sites is striking
(~80% come from uniandes-co-bogota)... Check on which analyses are conducted within
dataset and think about either subsampling CO data or doing within site analysis for
SEM") and the authors' own note (quoting Ben: "Could also fit on equal-sized subsamples
and show that parameters and ability scores are essentially unchanged").

Two complementary checks:
  1. Equal-size-per-site subsampling: repeatedly downsample every site to the size of
     the smallest site, refit the 3-factor model (mdl_3f, from _08-sem.qmd), and see
     whether the factor correlations / fit move much from the full-sample estimates.
  2. Within-site-only fits: fit the same model separately within each site (where N
     allows) to see whether the correlated-factor structure holds without any
     cross-site pooling at all.

Depends on `wide_scores`, `mdl_3f`, `fit_3f`, and `grab_fit()`, all built in
_08-sem.qmd. `wide_scores` carries `site_label` as an identifier column (prep_sem()
selects it but doesn't pivot on it), so it's available for grouping/subsampling here.
-->

```{r subsample-prep}
#| dependson: sem-factors

site_ns <- wide_scores |> count(site_label, name = "n") |> arrange(n)
site_ns

min_site_n <- min(site_ns$n)

# guard: bail loudly (rather than silently subsampling to ~0) if any site is
# implausibly small once the new data is in -- adjust threshold as needed.
stopifnot(min_site_n >= 30)
```

```{r subsample-functions}
extract_cors_3f <- function(fit) {
  parameterEstimates(fit, standardized = TRUE) |>
    filter(op == "~~", lhs != rhs, lhs %in% c("reasoning", "ef", "language")) |>
    transmute(pair = paste(lhs, rhs, sep = "-"), r = std.all)
}

fit_3f_on <- function(data) {
  sem(mdl_3f, data = data,
      estimator = "MLR", missing = "fiml", std.lv = TRUE, optim.method = "nlminb",
      control = list(iter.max = 50000, rel.tol = 1e-6))
}

# lavInspect(..., "converged") only means the optimizer stopped -- small
# subsamples (especially per-site fits) can "converge" to an inadmissible
# solution (non-positive-definite latent covariance matrix, |r| > 1, negative
# residual variances). Treat those as failures too, not just non-convergence.
fit_is_proper <- function(fit) {
  isTRUE(lavInspect(fit, "converged")) && isTRUE(lavInspect(fit, "post.check"))
}

draw_equal_site_subsample <- function(data, n_per_site, seed) {
  set.seed(seed)
  data |>
    mutate(.row = row_number()) |>
    slice_sample(n = n_per_site, by = site_label) |>
    select(-.row)
}
```

```{r subsample-refit}
#| cache: true

n_reps <- 200

subsample_results <- map(seq_len(n_reps), \(i) {
  sub_data <- draw_equal_site_subsample(wide_scores, min_site_n, seed = i)
  fit_i <- tryCatch(fit_3f_on(sub_data), error = function(e) NULL)
  if (is.null(fit_i) || !fit_is_proper(fit_i)) return(NULL)
  extract_cors_3f(fit_i) |> mutate(rep = i)
}) |>
  compact() |>
  bind_rows()

n_converged <- n_distinct(subsample_results$rep)
n_improper_or_failed <- n_reps - n_converged
if (n_improper_or_failed > n_reps * 0.1) {
  warning(
    n_improper_or_failed, " of ", n_reps, " subsample replicates failed to ",
    "fit or produced an improper solution -- that's a substantive result in ",
    "itself (equal-size-per-site samples may be too small/unstable for this ",
    "9-indicator model), not just noise to filter out silently."
  )
}
```

```{r}
#| label: tbl-subsample-robustness
#| tbl-cap: !expr glue::glue("Three-factor model correlations across equal-size-per-site subsamples, compared to the full-sample estimates. {n_converged} of {n_reps} replicates converged to a proper (admissible) solution and are summarized below.")

full_sample_cors <- extract_cors_3f(fit_3f) |> rename(r_full = r)

subsample_summary <- subsample_results |>
  summarise(
    r_mean = mean(r), r_sd = sd(r),
    r_q025 = quantile(r, .025), r_q975 = quantile(r, .975),
    .by = pair
  ) |>
  left_join(full_sample_cors, by = "pair")

subsample_summary |>
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric), \(x) round(x, 3))) |>
  rename(
    "Factor pair" = pair, "Subsample mean" = r_mean, "Subsample SD" = r_sd,
    "2.5%" = r_q025, "97.5%" = r_q975, "Full sample" = r_full
  ) |>
  flextable() |>
  autofit() |>
  align(j = c("Subsample mean", "Subsample SD", "2.5%", "97.5%", "Full sample"), align = "center", part = "all") |>
  bold(j = "Factor pair", bold = TRUE, part = "body") |>
  add_header_lines(values = glue::glue("Equal-size-per-site subsampling (n = {n_reps} replicates, n = {n_converged} proper)"))
```

```{r}
#| label: fig-subsample-robustness
#| fig-cap: !expr glue::glue("Factor correlations from {n_reps} equal-size-per-site subsamples (boxplots, n = {n_converged} proper solutions) vs. the full-sample estimate (red point), for each pair of first-order factors in the 3-factor model.")
#| fig-width: 6
#| fig-height: 4

ggplot(subsample_results, aes(x = pair, y = r)) +
  geom_boxplot(width = .4, outlier.shape = NA) +
  geom_jitter(width = .08, alpha = .15, size = .6) +
  geom_point(data = full_sample_cors, aes(y = r_full), color = "red", size = 2.5) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Factor correlation") +
  coord_flip()
```

```{r within-site-fits}
# Complementary check: fit the same 3-factor model separately within each
# site (no pooling at all). Sites too small to support a 9-indicator, 3-factor
# CFA are skipped with a message rather than silently failing.

min_n_for_cfa <- 100  # rough rule of thumb given 9 indicators / 3 factors; revisit once real Ns are known

within_site_results <- site_ns |>
  filter(n >= min_n_for_cfa) |>
  pull(site_label) |>
  map(\(site) {
    site_data <- wide_scores |> filter(site_label == site)
    fit_site <- tryCatch(fit_3f_on(site_data), error = function(e) NULL)
    if (is.null(fit_site) || !fit_is_proper(fit_site)) {
      message(glue::glue("within-site 3-factor model did not converge or was improper for {site}"))
      return(NULL)
    }
    extract_cors_3f(fit_site) |> mutate(site_label = site)
  }) |>
  compact() |>
  bind_rows()

skipped_sites <- site_ns |> filter(n < min_n_for_cfa) |> pull(site_label)
```

```{r}
#| label: tbl-within-site-robustness
#| tbl-cap: !expr glue::glue("Three-factor model correlations fit separately within each site (no cross-site pooling), for sites where the model produced a proper solution. {length(skipped_sites)} of {nrow(site_ns)} sites are omitted (see text) -- either below the {min_n_for_cfa}-participant threshold or because within-site estimation produced an improper solution.")

within_site_summary <- within_site_results |>
  left_join(full_sample_cors, by = "pair") |>
  select(site_label, pair, r, r_full)

within_site_summary |>
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric), \(x) round(x, 3))) |>
  rename("Site" = site_label, "Factor pair" = pair, "Within-site r" = r, "Full-sample r" = r_full) |>
  flextable() |>
  autofit() |>
  align(j = c("Within-site r", "Full-sample r"), align = "center", part = "all") |>
  bold(j = c("Site", "Factor pair"), bold = TRUE, part = "body")
```
